::: {#def-burnin}
#### Burn-in

The **burn-in** period is the initial segment of an MCMC chain
that is discarded before posterior summaries are computed
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 301].
For a chain $\vparam^{(1)}, \ldots, \vparam^{(T)}$
and a burn-in of $B$ draws,
the summaries use only the remaining draws $\vparam^{(B+1)}, \ldots, \vparam^{(T)}$.
:::
